claims.assertion: Swaruu says Akashic access is channeling the Ether/Source by matching a question's frequency; a library is only one person's metaphor for how information appears.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says answers can come from any timeline but are filtered by the questioner's thought-frequency and expectations; shared answers reflect agreements, not absolute truth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Swaruu says an emptier mind makes information more reliable; meditation practice can develop into channeling, even during another task without losing awareness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She describes multitasking access as her own practice.
